reserveReview.rationale: Ethereum block 26115200 (2026-10-03T23:47:59Z; hash 0x0049cb9fd66ba90ddc0b3fb89f299cd7644f5b55ef95dc09949f426f624a6e6f) binds implementation 0xf943cb8d5f06f2bbf352878ebef3ec5c537a20ba and its immutable USDC, USDS, sUSDS and PSM accounting. Held sUSDS and vault totalSupply both equal 160851641385946608970541089 base units. sUSDS.convertToAssets(held) is 178803692286874041546569087 USDS base units. Idle USDC is 1004961 base units; USDS rounding dust is 2683592584333002 base units; the implementation-linked DAI balance is zero. Gross book NAV at token-accounting par is 178803693.294518634130902089, comprising all three nonzero holdings, not native totalAssets (178803692286874 USDC base units), which excludes idle tokens. Percentages preserve both dust positions. Par is a book valuation convention, not market price, final USD realization, independent assurance or insolvency priority; upstream sUSDS, USDS and USDC backing remains linked. Unsolicited unrelated token transfers are not reserve-accounting claims.
